Title: Blob Storage GUID migration and name changes

Body.Content:
Starting December 1, 2018, resource GUIDs and names for Blob Storage will change. The name changes will not affect how the service operates. If you are reporting on the names of these resource GUIDs, you will need to modify your reports.
